subject: POC: Risk tracker, success criteria & next steps (Stellar Commerce)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: POC: Risk tracker, success criteria & next steps (Stellar Commerce)

Thanks again for a great call today — appreciate the clear context on the evaluation goals. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC plan, success criteria, owners, and immediate next steps so we can align and lock dates. Please reply with any changes.

POC scope (2-week trial):
- Integrate Redwood Hosted API with Stellar’s checkout service (traffic shadowing for 1% of sessions)
- Evaluate throughput and latency at 99th percentile for typical session lengths (avg 120 tokens)
- Validate output quality on 300 sample prompts (fraud detection and personalization prompts)

Success criteria (pass/fail):
1) Latency: 99p end-to-end < 250ms for shadowed requests
2) Cost: projected per-1000-token cost < $0.85 at typical batch sizes
3) Quality: >= 90% of responses match Golden set (300 prompts), and no critical regressions
4) Reliability: error rate < 0.5% over 48h window

Owners:
- POC lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — overall coordination, reports
- Technical lead (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) — integration, triage
- Stellar engineering owner: Alicia Gomez — test harness + sample data access

Timeline:
- Week 0 (Jun 28 — Jul 2): Integration + smoke tests
- Week 1 (Jul 5 — Jul 9): Run evaluation (300 prompts), collect metrics
- Week 2 (Jul 12 — Jul 16): Stabilize, run cost experiments and handoff decision call

Attachments: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan + checklist).
Next steps:
- Alicia: confirm access to the staging environment and provide sample prompts by EOD Mon (Jun 29)
- Rishi: will share the risk tracker template and test credentials by Tue
- Marissa: schedule a 30-min sync for Jul 6 to review interim metrics

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Alicia — answers below and updated items attached.

- Latency measurement: we recommend measuring end-to-end from your LB (client-side) for the most accurate production-like metrics. Redwood can also emit server-side spans if you want to cross-compare.
- PII: please redact or token-hash any PII in the sample prompts; Redwood will not persist any raw PII in logs for the trial and can enable stricter redaction on request.
- Trial agreement: for a 2-week evaluation we can proceed under email confirmation; if procurement requires a shorttrial MSA we can provide a one-page addendum.

I've attached the POC Risk Tracker (POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx) — please use this sheet to capture blockages, severity, owner, mitigation, and escalation path. We're tracking three initial risks:
1) Data access delays (Alicia owner) — severity: high — mitigation: temporary CSV upload
2) KV cache performance variance (Rishi owner) — severity: medium — mitigation: fall back to smaller sequence lengths / variant model
3) Procurement review (Tom owner) — severity: medium — mitigation: proceed under email confirmation or fast MSA

Connor will be the integration engineer on our side and will reach out to your infra team if we need help with LB measurement probes.

Attachment: POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx

-Marissa

Subject: [INF-2345] POC update: KV cache timeouts + mitigation

Quick status update — posting into the tracker and wanted to flag here since it impacts the Week 0 smoke tests.

Observed issue:
- During a short smoke run against your staging LB we saw repeated KV cache misses causing backend inference timeouts (~2-3s spikes) when sequences approached 512 tokens. Reproduced on our side with representative prompts.

Impact:
- Blocks the ability to validate 99p latency at target sequence lengths; affects success criterion #1.

Mitigation in place:
- Immediate fallback to a smaller sequence length profile (256 tokens) for the smoke tests to validate integration and correctness.
- Route traffic to the quantized model variant with a slightly higher memory overhead but faster KV handling for the duration of the POC.

Escalation / next steps:
- I've opened a tracker ticket: INF-2345 (engineering) — snapshot attached (INF-2345-ticket-snapshot.txt).
- ETA for a code fix that improves KV cache eviction behavior: 3 business days (targeting Thu, Jul 2).
- Connor will validate whether the fallback model variant maintains quality for the sample prompt set.

I'll keep this thread updated and have put the entry into POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx under "KV cache performance" (severity=high now).

-Rishi
